# Register section banners, verbatim from the GAPEKA 2025 PDF.
#
# Page 4 is here in full because it is the page that breaks a page -> category
# map: it holds the whole Argo section AND the start of Eksekutif, so train 1
# and train 32-33 are on one page in two different categories. Page 29 does the
# same for the first two freight sections. Page 32's head is the register's
# first duty roster: it carries a banner of its own, and its rows are not
# train rows at all.
# page 4
